findings.description: Probable (not Proved): Cornelius Hermanus Zacharias Booysen most likely died on 9 September 1942 at the hospital in Standerton, Transvaal, South Africa — usual residence Charl Cilliers, District Standerton; general farmer; cause of death coronary thrombosis. This rests on a single death information record, a Form of Information of a Death (B.M.D. 2), naming him exactly in the deceased field; it was the only tangible evidence of his death found. The conclusion is Probable rather than Proved because it is a single source with no independent corroboration of the death, and the record's implied birth year (~1902) is about four years off the tree's 1906 — an age estimate likely supplied by a non-family informant, explained but not independently resolved. The exact full-name match (all given names plus surname) anchors the identity but is not on its own enough to reach certainty. Note: the original FamilySearch hint record (a probate/death notice from the Master of the Supreme Court) is NOT his — that document is the death notice of Barend Christiaan Viljoen.
